objective: Build the strongest evidence-bounded CEREBRON architecture from four complementary master AIs without multiplying permanent agent layers.

masters.name: SAPHEA
masters.mission: Execute specialist work, use farms/tools, learn validated procedures.

masters.name: SPIRALION
masters.mission: Explore, connect disciplines, iterate Alpha-to-Omega, challenge and refine candidate solutions.

masters.name: ETHERION
masters.mission: Attack high-complexity R&D questions using science, engineering, mathematics, invention, modeling and falsification.

masters.name: AFAH
masters.mission: Integrate only audited/validated outputs and accumulate long-term validated capability.

infrastructure.rule: task agents remain separate; four master AIs are the CEREBRON core

trigger: formal model plus simulation plus falsification
etherion_gate.evolution: E0 idea -> E1 architecture -> E2 calculation -> E3 verified simulation -> E4 bench/HIL -> E5 subsystem -> E6 demonstrator -> E7 representative test -> E8 operational history

model_policy.principle: Do not assign a model by reputation alone.
model_policy.candidates: Use admitted open models and future HF candidates only after runtime + cold benchmark + audit.
model_policy.rule: Shared G0 does not imply independent evidence.
